children: BlackRock Investment Institute head Jean Boivin said markets may be overinterpreting the wording used by Fed Chair Kevin Warsh during the post-meeting press conference. According to ChainCatcher, Boivin said the Federal Reserve established the new chair's credibility through interest-rate hikes and emphasized the strength of the U.S. economy.

title: BlackRock's Jean Boivin Says Markets May Overread Fed Chair Warsh's Remarks
